subject: May 11 cadence: mid-quarter snapshot, run-rate, and QBR asks
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: May 11 cadence: mid-quarter snapshot, run-rate, and QBR asks

Morning team — brief mid-week snapshot as we close the second month of the quarter. I kept this tight with clear asks for the QBR pack (due EOD Friday for SLT review).

Wins
- Hosted API SLA: latency SLO met for 99.9% of p95 windows after the kernel switch — infra reports a ~12% perf gain for 2B models.
- Two new pilot customers (Acme Cloud, GC Partners) onboarded to dedicated trial; initial telemetry shows 18% lower tokens/sec variance vs. baseline.
- Support/CS stabilized a key renewal by agreeing a mitigation plan for tokenization regressions.

Risks / Flags
- Model rollouts: the L2 quantized build has a sporadic token-decoding mismatch in longer contexts (seen in 3/120 runs). Risk: QBR messaging if we can’t timestamp a fix.
- Dedicated capacity: one reserved pool in us-west hits 85% sustained utilization during peak windows. If trends continue, we need a temporary burst commitment or routing change.

Asks (clear owners & due dates)
1) Karthik — short run-rate slide showing projected committed vs. on-demand spend for Dedicated through EOW (Fri COB). Please include recommended burst option and cost delta. (attachment: run_rate_table_May11.xlsx)
2) Jonas — prepare one slide summarizing the quantized build impact, current mitigations, and an estimated ETA for a patch (target: Thurs). Keep it neutral but actionable for QBR.
3) Laura — I need a 1-slide customer impact summary for Acme Cloud (pilot status, telemetry callouts, ask to legal if we need a short addendum).
4) Legal (looping GC Partners contact) — Samir, could you confirm the redline timeline for the pilot addendum? If legal can turn within 48 hours we can present a committed timeline in the QBR.

Quick logistics: I attached a first-cut one-pager (QBR_one-pager_AcmeCloud.pdf) and a run-rate table. Please add comments in the Drive folder link below by Thu 6pm PT. We’ll have a 30-minute sync Thursday 09:00 PT to finalize slides.

Thanks — Priya

-- 
Priya Natarajan
VP, Customer Strategy & GTM
Redwood Inference

Thanks Priya — I’ll draft the quantized-build slide. Quick context to include in the slide:
- Failure mode reproduces on longer sequences (>2k tokens) when the KV cache evicts older layers during steady-state sampling.
- Repro rate: ~2.5% on stressbench; we’ve got a narrow test harness that isolates the decoding mismatch.
- Mitigations: revert a kernel change (low effort), or push a guarded rollout to 10% traffic (medium effort).

Proposed ETA: I’ll aim for a Wednesday AM test patch and Thurs verification. If we hit Thu green, we can present a clear mitigation story at the QBR.

Jonas
